title: The Great Timber and the Pliant Reed
summary: The mighty oak mocked the reed for bending in the breeze. A hurricane broke the oak's trunk in twain, while the pliant reed bowed with the wind and survived unhurt....
full_text: The mighty oak mocked the reed for bending in the breeze. A hurricane broke the oak's trunk in twain, while the pliant reed bowed with the wind and survived unhurt.
moral: The reed bends and rises, while the rigid oak snaps in the storm.
